handover_protocol.rule: At every continuation boundary, copy the prior CURRENT object unchanged into PREVIOUS, then replace CURRENT with the new complete handover object. Do not append an ever-growing handover history to ROADMAP.md.
handover_protocol.new_chat_start: Read CURRENT first, then fresh-reconcile GitHub main/open PRs/branches/CI before acting. CURRENT is a continuation snapshot, not a substitute for live GitHub truth.

lane.name: Culinary App / Culinary Lab — Corpus Scale / 100k Readiness
lane.rule: Do not perform ordinary Culinary Brain / Knowledge Core implementation from this lane.
lane.knowledge_core_boundary: Knowledge Core is read-only/reconciliation from this lane and must never become a private runtime dependency of the browser.
lane.nutrition_boundary: Nutrition remains an independent resumable lane and must not be overwritten by corpus-scale work.

operating_contract.autonomy: Proceed autonomously through technically resolvable roadmap work after fresh reconciliation.
operating_contract.user_facing_rule: No routine narration. Speak only for a genuine human gate, unrecoverable error, terminal material result, or continuation boundary.
operating_contract.fresh_reconciliation: Before every meaningful write or merge, fresh-reconcile main, open PRs, relevant branches, changed files, CI and concurrent work.
operating_contract.actions_cost: Do not spend GitHub Actions unless explicitly authorized by the user or current repository authority clearly permits the exact run.
operating_contract.continuation_rule: Before chat context becomes unreliable or when the user closes/transfers the lane, rotate PREVIOUS/CURRENT in GitHub and make CURRENT sufficient for a new chat to resume without copy-paste.

flow: Cloudflare Pages — lightweight private production surface
Cloudflare Access — exact-email allowlist + email OTP
Cloudflare Worker — small authenticated retrieval gateway
Cloudflare R2 — versioned recipe bodies, provenance and pre-built indexes
existing deterministic hard filters + evaluator + scorer + planner
accepted_architecture.provider_portability: No infrastructure provider is the canonical recipe source of truth; portable JSONL/JSON/manifests/rights ledgers/index-build artefacts must remain reproducible.

hard_access_constraint.rule: Only exact email addresses explicitly placed on the owner's allowlist may authenticate.
forbidden: treating identity verification as automatic membership
hard_access_constraint.public_github_rule: A public GitHub repository does not grant production app membership.

E.rule: Never all-or-nothing; admit only records/cohorts with verified content-level rights and provenance.

next_action.name: STEP_1_CORPUS_SCALE_CONTRACT_AND_SYNTHETIC_BENCHMARK_HARNESS
instructions: Fresh-reconcile main, open PRs and concurrent branches before implementation.

Create deterministic synthetic catalogues at approximately 1k, 10k, 50k and 100k records.

Measure record size, index size, candidate-set cardinality, transferred bytes, memory, retrieval latency, filter/ranking latency, build time and validation cost.
Define explicit acceptance thresholds before advancing.
Do not provision production Cloudflare resources in Step 1.
Do not ingest the new real external corpora in Step 1.
Do not add D1 in Step 1.
Do not change public recommendation behavior.
Do not introduce private Knowledge Core runtime dependencies.

terminal_instruction_for_new_chat: Open docs/handovers/CURRENT.json, fresh-reconcile GitHub against its written-against baseline, then pick up the next READY action from docs/ROADMAP.md and proceed autonomously. No handover copy-paste is required.
